At the beginning of this month, we pissed off the Trump White House.

Again.

[We ran a story on how](https://zeteo.com/p/trump-classified-documents-keep)
President Donald Trump is already planning to steal classified U.S. documents
after he leaves office a second time - just like he did the first time. The
West Wing got huffy about it.

"**Zeteo** **is a pathetic fake news blog and their so-called sources have no
idea what they 're talking about. Zeteo's three readers already know this
'publication' is total fake news**," the White House [told
us](https://bsky.app/profile/zeteo.com/post/3mpm3ztmrjc24) in an email. No one
signed their name. (If you read their statement closely, you'll notice they
did not deny any of our reporting… 🤣🤣🤣)

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

The federal government is waging a [nonstop](https://zeteo.com/p/don-lemon-
arrest-trump-minnesota-ice-church) [war](https://zeteo.com/p/so-much-for-free-
speech-a-year-of) on the First Amendment in ways that we haven't seen in the
United States in a _long,_ long time. On top of that, senior White House
officials constantly hurl childish taunts and bullshit smears at news
organizations that shine a light on what this corrupt, out-of-his-mind
president actually does.

Their enemies list includes **Zeteo**.

The Trump White House has publicly denounced us as "**[terrorist
sympathizers](https://bsky.app/profile/swin24.bsky.social/post/3mmweoelf7c2q)
,**" because we've reported on the [scandals and
lies](https://zeteo.com/p/trump-iran-war-pentagon-good-news) they've told
about their disastrous war on Iran. Vice President JD Vance went out of his
way to call our founder and editor-in-chief, **Mehdi Hasan** , a
"**[dummy](https://www.yahoo.com/news/jd-vance-slams-mehdi-
hasan-012800956.html).**" A White House spokesperson called Mehdi a
"**nutjob** " and "**such a terrible 'journalist**'" after **Zeteo** broke
news about Trump's push to spy more, not on foreign adversaries, [but on
](https://zeteo.com/p/trump-wants-to-spy-more-on-our-allies)_[U.S.
allies](https://zeteo.com/p/trump-wants-to-spy-more-on-our-allies)_.

Top MAGA ally and the world's richest man, Elon Musk, has been paying
attention to what Mehdi and **Zeteo** have been doing too and… [he doesn't
approve](https://www.foxnews.com/media/elon-musk-responds-former-msnbc-host-
calling-2028-democrats-prosecute-him)! Trump's "rapid response" team dubbed
Mehdi a terrorist-loving "**moron** ," simply because he called out the White
House press secretary's [bald-faced lies](https://zeteo.com/p/trump-white-
house-attack-zeteo-iran-war). The White House previously [branded
](https://zeteo.com/p/trump-threatens-
election-2020-replay)**[Zeteo](https://zeteo.com/p/trump-threatens-
election-2020-replay)** "**a fake news blogsite run by left-wing hacks that no
one should take seriously**." (They threw that particular hissy fit because we
dared to report on Trump and the GOP's [ongoing plots to steal
elections](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=p_YVJJUfWDI).) And I will forever
cherish the fact that the Trump White House issued a statement [labeling yours
truly a](https://zeteo.com/p/this-week-in-democracy-week-40-the) "**deranged
hack who couldn 't even hold a job at **_**Rolling Stone**_**and is now
writing for a[ Greta Thunberg](https://zeteo.com/p/the-worlds-silence-is-
deadly-greta) blog**." Despite all of their attacks, the Trump White House,
perhaps nursing some hurt feelings, has pretended not to know who we are,
emailing us, "**What the hell is a Zeteo?** " That was after we reached out
for comment regarding one of President Trump's [massive, failing leak
hunts](https://zeteo.com/p/reservoir-dogs-trumps-massive-leak).

They know what we are. And they're going to keep knowing.

[Share](https://zeteo.com/p/trump-white-house-
smears?utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&action=share)

the Daily Beast and _Rolling Stone,_ and I can honestly say that I've never
been prouder of the work I've done than when it's here with the hard-charging
team at **Zeteo**. You can tell a lot about someone from their enemies.
Clearly, **Zeteo** is getting under Team Trump's skin; we wouldn't be doing
our jobs right if we weren't.
